## HANDOFF ef6b75ef/132 — do the slot-31 dispatch owners touch the animator? (static)

Provenance **arena/ef6b75ef** · branch `arena/ef6b75ef-windwings-space-shooter-game-p` · code SHA `5ba12c56c` · claim **6435459104** · CI run **40462435663** (job `verify` success) · local **20 focused / 1890 full** · artifact `datas/l3_ef6b75ef132_native_dispatch_owners.json.gz` (11962 B, `5037ba3b…`).

**Closes review question 1 of 131 — the answer is a clean negative.** Stage 1 recovered the original FDE bodies of all 27 owners (16 slot-31 pool, 10 batch-container owners, `6b7d58`) and re-decoded them from raw bytes in the verifier:
- slot-31 pool: 16 owners, **266 `bl`**, **0 calls into `0x6b0000..0x6c0000`**, **0 references to any of the six containers**, one generic `+0x188` load in `0xe4515c`, 52 dispatch sites. So the update entry `6b947c` has **no recoverable static caller** in this build — only vtable membership plus 16 unrelated generic dispatch sites (slot 31 shipped 24×, 33 shipped 21×, 2 3×, 3 2×, 10 2×).
- batch owners: 160 `bl`, 8 cluster calls to `6b08c0/6b08d8/6b08e4/6b1c98/6b753c`, 10 container refs.
- `6b7d58`: 16 `bl`, 2 cluster calls (`6b8054`, `6b80e0`), 2 dispatch sites.

**The only real in-cluster dispatch is the graph builder on itself:** `6b7e00` `ldr x8,[x19]` → `6b7e0c` `ldr x8,[x8,#0x50]` → `blr` = slot 10 → `3e079c`; `6b7f48` → `6b7f50` `ldr x8,[x8,#0x108]` → `blr` = slot 33 → `6b6ab8`. Slot numbers resolved against the pinned cycle-130 membership.

**Correction to 131:** `0x10ecb08` is **not** animator-specific — 9 of its 10 referencing owners never enter the cluster and never read an animator field. Narrower true statement: inside `6b27dc` the container is iterated and each element flushed with `6b1c98(el,0)`, so it *can* hold animator objects. Its three cluster callees `6b08c0/6b08d8/6b08e4` are identical 3-instruction thunks (`mov w1,#8; mov w2,#8; b 0x3f1e30`) invoked on stack temporaries.

**Stage 2 attribution:** `6ce4b4` is its **own** FDE (`0x48`), not interior to the 129 output ctor `6ce464` (`0x34`) — the graph builder calls a different ctor; `6b7fe8` is interior to `6b7d58` (offset 656, an intra-function branch mislabelled as a call target by the naive scan and now flagged `intra`); `0x109acc0` has **no FDE** (stack-canary failure stub reached from `6b8050`).

**Not claimed:** no execution, no class names, no scheduler, no output-vtable `+0x28` resolution, bodies capped at `0x1000`. `0x8b3644`, `0xef4c68`, `0xf1d6bc` were truncated.

Next cycle candidate: the 129–130 producer pair `6b7d58` → `6cefdc` (per-node) is now fully bounded on the caller side; the cheapest remaining real step is `6b80e0`/`6b8054`, the two cluster helpers the builder calls, which have 0xE4 and 0x8C extents and have never been read.
